speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: 大丈夫か おい…
original_en: Hey, are you alright?

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: …痛みを感じる
original_en: I feel pain...

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: しっかりしろよ 不死者らしくないぜ
original_en: Come on! That doesn't sound very undead!

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: 急がねば レナスが危ない…
original_en: We need to hurry. Lenneth is in danger...

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: そうは言っても今の俺達じゃ同じ事の繰り返しだろ？
original_en:
Yeah, sure. But what the heck can we do?
Look at the state we're in.

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: こいつらも頼りにならないしな…
original_en:
And I don't think these two will be any
help.

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: 無駄だ そいつらは浮〓する魂とは違う
original_en: It's useless. These aren't floating souls.

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: “王呼の秘法”の〓縛から逃れられない行き場を失ったヴァルキリーの精神だ
original_en:
These are displaced valkyrie spirits that
can't escape the Sovereign's Rite.

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: いずれ消えゆく…
original_en: They will fade away...

speaker: Arngrim
original_jp: 戦力は残された俺達だけって事か…
original_en: So it's just down to us now, huh?

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: いや レナスの魂を取り戻せば新たな戦力を生み出せる <PART> ――
original_en:
No. If we regain Lenneth's soul, that will
give us a new weapon.

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: レザードはレナスと〓合する気でいた…
original_en: Lezard is intent on melding with Lenneth.

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: その前に私を器にして三姉〓の魂を〓合させヴァルキリーの力を一つにするのだ！
original_en:
Before he can do that, I shall become
the vessel of the three valkyries,
concentrating their power into one!

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: その力ならばレザードに対抗できる…
original_en:
Only then will we stand a chance of
opposing Lezard.

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: …そこまでしなきゃならないのか？
original_en: Are you sure that's the only way?

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: みんな見たはずだ敵はオーディンを〓ぐ神なのだ
original_en:
You saw for yourself! We face a god who
surpasses Odin!

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …私を
original_en: Let me...

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 私を器にさせてください！
original_en: Let me be the vessel!

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 何を言い出すかと思えば…
original_en: Are all of you people crazy?

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: シルメリアを肉体に宿すのとはわけが違うぞ！
original_en:
It won't be the same as sharing your
body with Silmeria.

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: 器も〓め四つの魂を〓合させ 全く別の魂を持つ存在に生まれ変わるのだ！
original_en:
All four souls, including the vessel's, will
be fused to create an entirely new being!

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: かつて私がディランという男と〓合し自らの存在を隠したようにな…
original_en:
Much as I once melded with a man named
Dylan and concealed my identity...

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 彼女達と一つになる事で私が望む未来を得られるのなら <PART> ――
original_en:
I can create the future I want by becoming
one with them. If I can do that...

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 私の人格が〓み込まれ元に戻れなくなっても構いません！
original_en:
Then I don't care what happens to me.
Even if I lose my personality and can't
go back!

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: その肉体では負〓が大き過ぎる長くは持たないだろう
original_en:
The strain on your body will be too much.
You won't be able to sustain it for long.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 〓を負ったあなたでは〓更です！
original_en: Neither can you! You're injured.

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: …肉体が崩壊すれば魂も消滅するぞ
original_en: When your body fails, the soul will fade.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 構いません！
original_en: I don't care!

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 軽々しく言うんじゃねぇッ！
original_en: How can you say you don't care!?

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: 俺とお前と どれだけ辛い思いをしてここまで来たか よく考えろよ…
original_en:
Please, think about what you're saying!
Think of everything you and I have been
through to reach this place!

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …考えたの
original_en: I have.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 考えてたのよ ずっと…
original_en: I've been thinking about it a long time.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: 小さい頃からずっと シルメリアから離れたいと思っていたのに <PART> ――
original_en:
Ever since I was little, I always wanted
to be separate from Silmeria.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: その願いが叶った時 私は空っぱだった…
original_en: but once it happened, I felt so empty.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: その時… 初めて思ったの
original_en: And that was when I realized...

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: シルメリアが必要だ って…
original_en: I need Silmeria.

speaker: Brahms
original_jp: 覚悟はわかった
original_en: I see you're ready.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …ルーファス
original_en: Rufus...

speaker: Rufus
original_jp: もう言うな… 俺もわかった
original_en: You don't have to say it... I know.

speaker: Alicia
original_jp: …行きましょう！
original_en: Let's do it.
